| `HKE120-EH23_Manual.pdf` | User manual as linked from the current [product page](https://www.tesmart.com/products/hke120-eh23), 28 pages; same content with a preface and copyright page added | https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0271/3429/6200/files/HKE120-EH23_Manual.pdf?v=1707294367 | uploaded 2024-02-07 (the `v=` timestamp) | `87809c4fd9b5b98f…` |
| `HKE12MMA10_Manual.pdf` | Two-page manual of the older HKE12MMA10 model | https://support.tesmart.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/15063330921625 (from [this support page](https://support.tesmart.com/hc/en-us/articles/15063353499673-HKE12MMA10)) | PDF created 2023-01-14 | `45598abef8be140a…` |

**Both HKE120-EH23 manuals are "old version" manuals.** Both predate TESmart's June-2024 split, and
both still say, in their notes: "For normal use, it is necessary to disable the IGMP when connecting
to an Ethernet switch." No manual for the new version (the one that "supports IGMP authentication",
see the [FAQ copy](tesmart-hke120-eh23-faq.md)) is published: the product page still links the
2024-02-07 file (checked 2026-11-21).

**The PDFs are not in the public repository.** The manuals' copyright notice says: "The user manual,
compiled by Tesla Elec Technology Co.,Ltd, shall not be duplicated or translated by any person or
organizations without written permission." Download them from the links above; the checksums tell
you whether you have the same file.
